description: DFCI - Tronçons de pistes catégorisées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Gard. La protection des forêts contre les incendies est une préoccupation majeure dans tout le bassin méditerranéen. Pour intervenir de façon optimale en cas d’incendie et protéger les biens des personnes et préserver les espaces naturels, un réseau de pistes DFCI a été défini sur le territoire. Coverage: Département du Gard. The publisher named on the listing is Département du Gard. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
